title: Ultrasound in Diagnosing Patients With Skin Lesions
brief_summary: This trial studies the use of a novel non-invasive ultrasound technique in diagnosing patents with skin lesions. Diagnostic procedures, such as ultrasound, may be a less invasive way to check skin lesions for skin cancer and other skin disorders.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Candidate with skin lesions.
* Signed study-specific informed consent prior to study entry.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior surgery or radiotherapy to the area to be treated.
